_language.name: English
app.title: CETUS
app.subtitle: Cue Exposure Therapy (CET) with urge-specific coping skills
login.title: Clinician sign-in
admin.title: Administrator access
admin.key_prompt: Enter the administrator key to recover access (reset passwords or create accounts).
admin.default_warning: You are using the default administrator key. Change it for security with "Change administrator key".
admin.backup_intro: Create a backup (database + media) or restore from one. Restoring replaces the current data and requires restarting CETUS; a copy of the current data is saved first.
admin.restore_invalid: That file is not a CETUS backup.
admin.restore_confirm: Restore the backup from {date} ({n} patient(s))? Current data will be replaced (a pre-restore copy is saved) and CETUS will close to restart.
admin.restore_done: Data restored. CETUS will close; reopen it to continue.
admin.storage_intro: Where this installation's data lives and how large it is.
admin.data_intro: Export, anonymize, or permanently delete a patient's data. Destructive actions require typing the patient's code to confirm.
admin.data_export_done: Export created: {files} file(s) in the bundle.
admin.data_anonymize_confirm: Type the code “{code}” to anonymize (name, birth year and notes are cleared; sessions are kept).
admin.data_anonymize_done: Personal data for {code} removed; sessions kept.
admin.data_no_backup_warn: You haven't created a backup this session. Continue with deletion anyway?
admin.data_delete_confirm: Type the code “{code}” to PERMANENTLY delete the patient and ALL their data and media. This cannot be undone.
admin.data_delete_done: Patient {code} and all their data deleted.
admin.clinicians_intro: Edit, disable or delete clinician accounts and transfer patients between them. A disabled account can't log in but keeps its history.
admin.clinician_not_self: You can't disable or delete your own signed-in account.
admin.clinician_no_target: There is no other account to transfer to.
admin.clinician_delete_confirm: Delete the account “{who}”? This cannot be undone.
admin.clinician_owns: Can't delete: the account has {pats} patient(s) and {sess} session(s). Transfer the patients or disable it.
admin.clinic_intro: Clinic details shown in the report header.
admin.reports_intro: Cross-patient reports: cohort summary, per-clinician activity and an aggregate PDF. Filter by clinician or include everyone.
admin.reports_empty: No data for the selected filter.
disclaimer.title: Important clinical notice
disclaimer.body: CETUS is a complementary tool to support therapy, used under professional supervision. It is NOT a standalone treatment and does not replace clinical care. Cue exposure can provoke intense craving. Use only under professional supervision and with a safety plan. You can stop the session at any time with the STOP button.
disclaimer.accept: I understand and agree to continue
dashboard.title: Clinician dashboard
dashboard.no_patients: No patients yet. Add the first one to get started.
addclinician.title: Add clinician
patient.code_hint: Do not use the real name. E.g.: PT0001
patient.archive_confirm: Archive patient {code}? They will no longer appear in the list (their data is kept).
report.title: Clinical report — Patient {code}
report.exploratory_caveat: Exploratory, descriptive metrics — small sample, no statistical inference. For clinical support under supervision, not as an outcome measure.
report.include_notes: Include clinician notes in the PDF
report.disclaimer: Exploratory clinical data — for internal use only, under professional supervision.
report.no_dwell_data: No cue dwell data recorded for this session.
cueconfig.title: Cues for {code}
cueconfig.intro: Select and order the cues from lower to higher intensity (rank). Mark personal positive images as a "reason for recovery".
cueconfig.add_folder_tip: Imports every media file in the folder and its subfolders.
cueconfig.empty: No cues configured. Add media for this patient.
cueconfig.library_empty: The media/ folder has no files for this category.
cueconfig.suggest_tip: Proposes a low→high craving order from the ratings (for you to review).
cueconfig.suggest_intro: Suggested low→high craving order from this patient's ratings (smoothed with data from other patients). Review before applying — it's a guide, not a rule.
setup.title: Prepare exposure
setup.no_cues: No active cues for this substance. Configure them before starting.
setup.random_overrides_adaptive: Note: with random order on, the suggested graded (adaptive) order is overridden for this session; learning is unaffected.
setup.loop_cues: Loop cues (does not stop at the end)
setup.params_intro: Settings for this session only. They start from the global values and do not change them.
consent.title: Session consent
consent.body: The patient agrees to take part in this supervised exposure session and knows they can stop it at any time.
consent.checkbox: The patient gives consent for this session
exposure.title: Exposure session
exposure.waiting: Look at the image. Let the craving arise and then subside.
exposure.legend: Keyboard mode: ← → change cue · 1 size · 2 blur · 3 dim · +/− adjust the chosen axis · 0 mute · 4 cope · 5 positive · on the craving scale, type the number and Enter.
exposure.legend_pick_axis: Pick an axis first (1 size, 2 blur, 3 dim), then use +/−.
exposure.fullscreen_hint: 1 size · 2 blur · 3 dim · +/− adjust · 4 cope · 5 positive
intensity.title: Control the intensity
vas.question: How strong is your urge to use right now?
uscs.title: Urge-specific coping skills
uscs.intro: Work through these steps to manage the urge. Each step is an evidence-based skill.
uscs.name_feeling.title: Name what you feel
uscs.name_feeling.prompt: What emotion and physical sensation do you notice right now? Describe them in your own words.
uscs.recall_negative.title: Recall a negative consequence
uscs.recall_negative.prompt: Think of something using has cost you. What did you lose or what harm did it cause?
uscs.recall_benefit.title: Recall a benefit of not using
uscs.recall_benefit.prompt: What do you gain by staying substance-free? Something that matters to you today.
uscs.alternative_action.title: Choose an alternative action
uscs.alternative_action.prompt: What can you do instead right now? A concrete, doable action.
gallery.title: Positive images
gallery.intro: Look at something that does you good. Stay here as long as you need.
gallery.empty: Add images to the media/positive folder or mark them as a reason for recovery.
calm.title: You are safe. Breathe.
calm.body: The session has stopped. Take a moment. Breathe in slowly… hold… breathe out slowly.
summary.title: Session summary
summary.slope_hint: A negative slope means craving decreased during the session (the desirable pattern).
settings.title: Clinic settings
settings.autoscroll_hint: Advance to the next cue automatically. Off by default.
settings.autoscroll_on_grading: Advance after each craving rating (periodic or peak)
settings.accessibility_hint: Drive the exposure with an adaptive keyboard (Enter, +, −, arrows, 0–9). Full detail in Help. Applies on the next session.
settings.accessibility_kbmode: Enable keyboard-only mode in the exposure
settings.shared_note: Shared with all users of this clinic.
settings.advanced_hint: Extra craving measurements, beyond the fixed periodic interval. Both off by default.
settings.vas_every_n_cues: Measure craving every N cues (0 = disabled)
settings.adaptive_ordering_hint: CETUS learns from the ratings which cues provoke more craving for each patient and suggests a low→high order. The clinician reviews and applies it in the cue library; it never changes a live session.
settings.vas_per_cue_seconds: Measure craving after N seconds on the same cue (0 = disabled)
settings.progressive_hint: Gradually applies a down-regulation lever over the session duration. The progressive value acts as a floor: the patient can increase it but not decrease below it.
settings.auto_coping_enabled: Open coping automatically on consecutive high scores
settings.session_options_hint: Defaults; adjustable per session with the Parameters button.
settings.hotkeys_intro: Remap the key for each action. Keyboard-only actions are restricted to the adaptive-keyboard keys.
settings.hotkeys_apply_note: Global shortcuts apply immediately; exposure shortcuts on the next session.
settings.hotkey_conflict: That key is already assigned to another action in the same group.
settings.hotkey_not_in_keyset: For the accessible mode use only: numbers 0–9, +, −, arrows or Enter.
settings.branding_intro: The clinic logo and name appear in the header of PDF reports.
settings.substances_intro: Add substances beyond the 3 built-in ones. Each creates its folder under media/ and appears in the menus. Removing one only hides it; patient and session data are kept.
settings.substance_builtin_locked: Built-in substances cannot be removed. Select a custom one.
settings.substance_remove_confirm: Remove "{name}" from the menus? Associated data is kept.
error.codec: This media could not be played. Check the format (MP4 H.264 / MP3 recommended).
error.save_failed: Could not save. Check permissions and disk space.
report.export_failed: Could not generate the file. Check the path, permissions, and disk space.
